La Parka; Justin Hicks d. Castor Troy in a King Of The Ring semi-final; Terry Conklin d. Aaron Martin; Harlem Heat d. The Ultimate Fighters (Dan Severn & Ken Shamrock); Thorne Richards d. As soon as Richards came into the ring, The Golden One and The King of Swing began to brawl. A thumb to the eye by The Golden One on Stevie gave the Shining Star the advantage. After a few high impact moves, the Golden One slapped a reverse chinlock on Stevie. Stevie began to fade into the black sea of unconsciousness, and The Golden One demanded that The referee check Stevie. The Referee raised Stevie’s arm two times and it dropped like a sack of bricks. On the third raise, Stevie held his arm up and began to shake wildly, as the crowd erupted. He managed to get to his feet and delivered three brutal elbows into the stomach of the Golden One. The Golden One released the hold, and was then hit with a sweet standing dropkick by Richards. Richards then yelled “Ariba!” and nailed the Golden one with a brutal flying forearm. Richards went for the pin, but the Golden One kicked out at 2.5 seconds. The Golden One attempted a quick lariat, but ended up knocking out the referee. Stevie suplexed the shining star, and set him up for the Stevie Kick. Suddenly, Shawn Copeland and Jeff Bunda rushed out from the back, and began to pummel the two wrestlers in the ring. Venom and Crazy Canuck, with chairs in hand, came down and began to battle with the two triple threat members. The Golden One used a high knee lift to take down Jeff Bunda, and he than began to beat Bunda brutally with his fists. Copeland then dropkicked the Golden One in the face, sending him flying to the outside. After the brawl was cleared away, EWA officials declared the match a draw.

E-Nuff' was definately giving up the size and power atvantage in this match but this was also his chance to prove that he could defeat a 4 time Ewa World Champion so he was eager to give the big man a wrestling lesson and in the beginning it was a brawl in the center of the ring for the first couple of minutes with E-Nuff losing but he showed a new found fire and it showed he wouldn't back down even though outpowered. But the big man missed with a clothesline and The Harcore Champ made him pay for the mistake with a kick to the sturnum followed by a short arm clothesline. He punished the big man with technical moves such as a bulldog, a swinging neckbreaker, a diving headbutt and another bulldog from the second ropes and then a spinning heel kick which he nailed and went for the cover 1..2,... kickout with authority. He basically threw E-Nuff' off him like a rag doll and Draven sprang to his feet and in one fluid motion as E-Nuff was getting up as well hit him with a side kick flush on the jaw. Now it was E-Diddy's turn to dish out the Punishment and he did just that nailing lefts and rights, irish whip into a flapjack, he then nailed The Hardcore Champ with a press slam and a tiger bomb before going for the cover and pulling him up at the 2 count. He hit his opponent with a belly to belly suplex before signaling for what used to be called the Dx Driver at the 14:24 mark but E-Nuff had the move well scouted and blocked the move and instead hit him with a neckbreaker and then locked in the crossface. Draven Struggled but managed to hold on until the bell sounded for a draw.
